rows.note: For bodily pain or an ache, this is the all-purpose Cantonese noun.

example.english: My leg still has some pain.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 zung6 jau5 di1 tung3

rows.note: Use this for mental or emotional suffering rather than a merely physical ache.

example.english: I was in a lot of pain after the breakup.
example.traditional: 失戀嗰段時間，我好痛苦。
example.jyutping: sat1 lyun2 go2 dyun6 si4 gaan3 ngo5 hou2 tung3 fu2

rows.note: Use this when the annoying pain is a thing or situation rather than a person.

example.english: This annoying thing is a real pain.
example.traditional: 呢件麻煩嘢真係煩死人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 maa4 faan4 je5 zan1 hai6 faan4 sei2 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an annoying or troublesome person.

example.english: They’re such a pain, always asking me for help.
example.traditional: 佢真係個麻煩友，成日搵我幫手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 maa4 faan4 jau5 seng4 jat6 wan2 ngo5 bong1 sau2
